## Assessment

✅ **System healthy** — 123 loops, no INCONCLUSIVE backlog

**Champion holding well**: Better tuning consistency and tighter drawdown control.

**Last PASS notable**: Improved lockbox minimum (1.35 vs 1.13) suggests better tail performance, but the 0.05 tuning minimum and -11.2% MDD are concerning for robustness.


**ETA to next checkpoint**: ~35 hours remaining in budget.
